summary: Horizon Space Acquisition I Corp. filed a Form 8-K disclosing the issuance of an unsecured promissory note in the principal amount of $500,000 to its sponsor for general working capital. The note bears no interest and is payable upon the earliest of a business combination or the expiry of the company's term. The sponsor may convert the note into private units upon a business combination. This is a routine SPAC working capital loan, not a special situation event.
